The apply_template returned '()' meaning no applicable outcome? Possibly the template is forward reaction? The template ID 1914384 corresponds to a forward reaction mapping given earlier: mapped_rxn: '([CH3:1]/[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)=[CH:9]/[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C:13](=[O:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18])>>([CH3:1][C@H:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18])'

So forward reaction: starting material is something with CH3 attached to C (maybe a carbonyl?) and product is the target molecule (with CH3 attached to chiral center). The template likely does a reduction of a carbonyl to alcohol? Actually forward: substrate: [CH3:1]/[C:2]([c:3]... )=[CH:9]/[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C:13](=[O:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18] -> product: [CH3:1][C@H:2]... [C@@:13]1([OH:14])...

So forward reaction is a cyclization? Not sure. But applying template to product (target) should give precursors: the substrate (maybe a carbonyl) and maybe something else? The template likely is a reverse of forward: product -> substrate (precursor). However apply_template returned none, maybe because the template expects a specific pattern not matching due to stereochemistry or aromatic ring? The target SMILES includes [C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])... The forward template had [C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14]) as product. So should match.

But maybe the tool expects the template ID to be retrieved first? Could need to get_template to retrieve SMARTS? Let's try get_template.
